notes: Official API model ID qwen-flash, currently equivalent to snapshot qwen-flash-2025-07-28. Text-only; 1,000,000-token context window, maximum input 997,952 tokens and maximum output 32,768 tokens. Pricing is tiered by input tokens per request: up to 256K, and 256K to 1M; the tier applies to every token in the request. The model page lists batch-file rates for Singapore but also marks batch inference as unsupported there, so no batch price is represented. Prices are USD list prices for the International (Singapore) scope; the official model page states that it shows original prices excluding limited-time promotions.

price_records.billing_note: Standard list pricing for requests with 256,000 or fewer input tokens, International (Singapore) deployment scope; the US scope lists the same rates, while the Global and Chinese mainland scopes publish lower rates. Cached input is the implicit (automatic) cache-hit rate. Explicit caching is a separate opt-in mode with a 5-minute TTL: creation $0.063 and reads $0.005 per 1M tokens.

Standard list pricing for requests with more than 256,000 input tokens (up to 1M); the tier applies to the whole request. International (Singapore) deployment scope; the US scope lists the same rates, while the Global and Chinese mainland scopes publish lower rates. Cached input is the implicit (automatic) cache-hit rate. Explicit caching is a separate opt-in mode with a 5-minute TTL: creation $0.313 and reads $0.025 per 1M tokens.
